decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core drainage engineering offer, was given its own page at launch, and is likely a platform component for broader system sales.

As the firm's flagship design-oriented shower drainage line, it is highly aligned with strategy and therefore very unlikely to be removed so soon after launch.
